listing.name: Pokémon Emerald (Gen1Recomp / G1R Deluxe)
listing.summary: Import your own exact emerald original through Gen1Recomp, then register its selected game player. Runtime updates and profiles stay upstream-owned.

steps.title: Use this exact original game
steps.instruction: Use your own canonical US English emerald original: revision 1.0, 16 MiB, SHA-1 f3ae088181bf583e55daf962a92bb46f4f1d07b7. Another game, region or unlisted revision is a different input. The upstream importer checks SHA-1; Portcove registration does not authenticate the original or cache.

steps.title: Complete the upstream import and select this player
steps.instruction: Use only the official bryanthaboi/gen1recomp release or gen1re.com distribution. Extract the complete Windows ZIP and keep gen1recomp.exe with its supplied companions. Run upstream setup deliberately, then select this game’s plain original .gb or .gba file in its importer. Completing import may start the game automatically; this is an explicit upstream launch, not a passive Portcove file check. Let import finish and verify this game’s tab before registration. Register gen1recomp.exe in gen1recomp-win64 with that containing directory as working directory and one literal argument, --game=emerald. Do not select another game’s cache or a console/emulator/helper.

steps.title: Preserve all actual player and game data
steps.instruction: Normal desktop data uses LÖVE’s OS user save directory with identity pokemon-love2d (normally %APPDATA%/LOVE/pokemon-love2d on Windows). portable.txt beside gen1recomp.exe redirects saves/options/generated data to that writable player folder, but updates/ payloads remain in the OS save directory. Preserve both actual locations, all imported game caches, saves/ slots and legacy save files, options and backup/staged witnesses, mods, kept original copies, imports/exports, screenshots and custom profiles. Games have distinct saves but share options and runtime. Removing the marker switches roots without moving progress. Close the player before copying/replacing anything; keep the creating runtime and originals. No automatic save/cache conversion or populated-data adoption is promised.

steps.title: Keep upstream ownership and explicit actions
steps.instruction: The standalone upstream player owns its update checks and can mount an updated Lua payload from the OS profile. Let upstream own that complete installation and profile. This entry uses non-owning registration, explicit Play and registration-only removal; Managed Update, Backup, Rollback, migration and external deletion are unavailable. It does not use or alter Red’s separate Core-managed definition or its managed-package environment. The generated cache is private original-derived data; preserve your original outside it, and preserve any separately kept-ROM copy when offered. Use the importer’s explicit consent choices; no original is downloaded or supplied by Portcove.

warnings: Upstream marks GBA FireRed/LeafGreen/Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald support beta. This game has no inherited Red Windows, gameplay or save acceptance.
Use the official repository or gen1re.com. Upstream warns that a similarly named unofficial download site distributes adware.
